card.name: Anticipating cross-border and foreign topics
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or punctuation just before text about crossing borders, foreign countries, studying abroad or international movement. The marked word itself is often bland, such as a space, 'as', 'that' or a period.

modes.label: Study abroad and migration
modes.description: Gap or linking word just before a statistic or phrase about students abroad or migrants.

modes.label: International trade and spread
modes.description: Linking word or preposition before text on cross-border trade, transport or spread between countries.

modes.label: Initials in foreign-themed text
modes.description: Period after an initial in citations or names tied to Japan, immigrants or missionaries.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about crossing borders, studying abroad and foreigners, mostly Chinese terms plus 'foreign' and 'foreigners'.
card.plain: It fires on filler words in passages about foreign countries, going abroad or crossing borders, and nudges the next words toward those themes.
